summary.text: Wendy DeBoer is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 10, and was elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Wendy DeBoer's occupation as an educator and a former lawyer.

paragraphs.text: Wendy DeBoer was born on May 16, 1974, in Omaha.

Wendy DeBoer graduated from Burke High School in 1992, earned a B.A. in economics and English from Hastings College in 1996 and a J.D. from the University of Nebraska College of Law in 1999, and went on to earn graduate degrees from the University of Nebraska Omaha, Lutheran School of Theology at Chicago and Syracuse University.
Wendy DeBoer is a member of Holy Cross Lutheran Church.
